title: Wonder if it’s bad to go with them then. Safe in one way. Turns milk, makes fiddlestrings snap. Something about withering plants I read in a garden.
html_source: Bloom wonders about having sex with a menstruating woman. “Safe in one way” might refer to little risk of pregnancy. The following statements about turning milk, snapping strings, and withering plants are all folk-beliefs about menstruation.
